DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何がありましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪場の自転車がありません。この鍵の番号で調べられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐輪場で見つからない自転車を鍵番号で調べられるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My bicycle is missing from the bicycle parking area. Can you look it up using the number on this key?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the bicycle missing from the bicycle parking area can be looked up using its key number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 鍵の番号と防犯登録番号は別です。管理者による移動は確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: The key number and bicycle security registration number are different. Have you checked whether the management moved it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 管理室では今日は移動していないと言われました。登録番号の控えは家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 管理者の移動はなかったと確認し防犯登録控えは自宅にあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The management office told me they have not moved any bicycles today. My copy of the registration number is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you confirmed the management had not moved it and that your security registration record is at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今分かる車体の特徴と、置いた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me the bicycle's features that you know now and where you left it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い車体で、後ろの泥よけに白い傷があります。入口から三列目に置きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体色と傷と駐輪した列を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a blue frame and a white scratch on the rear mudguard. I left it in the third row from the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe in Japanese the bicycle's color, scratch, and the row where you parked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真はありますか。よく似た別の自転車との区別に役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have a photo? It would help distinguish it from another very similar bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 購入時の写真があります。かごはその後交換したので、写真とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入写真を提示しかごが撮影後に交換されたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a photo from when I bought it. I replaced the basket afterward, so it is different from the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the purchase photo and explain in Japanese that the basket was replaced after the photo was taken.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 交換後の状態も記録しましょう。登録控えは後で確認できたら知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us record what it looks like after the replacement too. Please let us know the registration details if you can check your record later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今のかごは銀色です。写真と変更点を伝え、帰宅後に登録番号の控えを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在のかごの色を補足し帰宅後に登録番号を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The current basket is silver. I will show the photo and explain what has changed, then check my copy of the registration number when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Add the current basket's color and explain in Japanese that you will check the registration number after you get home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。最後に見た時刻から順に伺います。こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask you about what happened, starting with when you last saw it. This way, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。お荷物の発送ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you sending a parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 申請書の原本を送りたいです。まだ封はしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未封の申請書原本を発送したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to send the original application form. I have not sealed the envelope yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to send an original application form that has not yet been sealed in its envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の宛先を確認しましょう。原本の内容を手元に残す必要はありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check the address on the envelope. Do you need to keep a record of the original document's contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 問い合わせのときに必要ですが、コピーを取るのを忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問い合わせ用コピーをまだ取っていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will need it when making inquiries, but I forgot to make a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not yet made the copy needed for inquiries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは複写を承れません。コピーを用意してから封を閉じますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot make copies here. Would you like to get a copy ready before sealing the envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。原本を持ってコピーを取り、戻ってから発送したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 窓口では複写できないため原本を持ってコピーを取りに行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will do that. I would like to take the original to make a copy, then come back and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that, because copies cannot be made at the counter, you will take the original with you to make a copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、今回はまだお預かりしません。戻られたら中身と宛先を再確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we will not take the documents from you yet. Please check the contents and address again when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 写しを誤って送らないよう、原本には付箋を付けて区別します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: コピーを送らないよう付箋で原本を区別する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will mark the original with a sticky note so I do not send the copy by mistake.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you plan to distinguish the original with a sticky note so you do not send the copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 封入時には付箋を外してください。控え用のコピーは鞄へ別に入れると区別できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please remove the sticky note when putting the document in the envelope. Keeping your copy separately in your bag will help distinguish them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: コピーを別にしまい、原本から付箋を外して封入します。今は発送を待ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: コピーを別保管し原本の付箋を外して封入するため今は発送を保留すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put the copy away separately, remove the sticky note from the original, and put the original in the envelope. Please hold off on sending it for now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to hold off on sending it while you store the copy separately and remove the sticky note from the original before enclosing it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類をお返しします。戻られましたらお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here are your documents back. Please let us know when you return.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。申込書でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are you having difficulty with the application form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 勤務先の住所をどちらにすればいいか分かりません。本社と毎日働く現場が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務先住所欄で本社と実際の現場のどちらを書くか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not know which address to put for my workplace. The head office and the site where I work every day are different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether to enter the head office or your actual worksite in the workplace address field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 雇用主と働く場所が別なのですね。契約書などで会社名を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: So your employer and the place where you work are different. Can you check the company name on your employment contract or a similar document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書には本社の会社名があります。現場の看板は別の会社です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雇用契約の会社名と現場の看板の会社名が異なると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The contract has the head office's company name. The sign at the worksite has a different company name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the company name on your employment contract differs from the company name on the worksite sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 看板の会社名を雇用主として書かず、担当が資料を確認して記入をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not enter the company on the sign as your employer. The person in charge will check the documents and explain how to fill in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに現場の名前を書いてしまいました。署名前に訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現場名を記入済みなので署名する前に訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have already written the worksite name here. I would like to correct it before signing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have already written the worksite name and want to correct it before signing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだ署名されていませんね。訂正方法も担当へ確認します。今日その契約書はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have not signed yet, have you? I will also check with the person in charge how to make the correction. Do you have that contract with you today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯に契約書の控えがあります。住所は本社の欄と現場の欄に分かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯に本社と現場の住所が分かれた契約書控えがあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a copy of the contract on my phone. The addresses are listed in separate head office and worksite fields.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have a copy of the contract on your phone, with separate addresses for the head office and worksite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な箇所だけ担当へ提示してください。こちらで携帯を預かる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show only the necessary parts to the person in charge. There is no need for us to take your phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分で画面を開き、本社と現場の欄を見せます。記入方法が分かってから署名します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯を自分で操作して両欄を示し記入方法の確認後に署名すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will open the screen myself and show the head office and worksite fields. I will sign after I understand how to fill it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will operate your phone yourself to show both fields and sign after confirming how to fill in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込書を添えて担当へご案内します。少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take you to the person in charge with your application form. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。惣菜売場でお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Can I help you in the prepared foods section?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の容器に惣菜を入れたいです。家で量ったので、そのまま入れていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参容器へ量り売り惣菜を家で量った容器重で入れてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to put some prepared food in my own container. I weighed it at home, so may I put the food straight in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may put food sold by weight straight into your own container using the container weight you measured at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では、先に空の容器を売場で量ってからお入れします。容器は空ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this case, we will weigh the empty container here in the section first, then put the food in. Is the container empty?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空です。家ではふたを外して量りましたが、今日はふた付きで持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空容器で持参したが自宅計量時はふたを外していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is. At home I weighed it without the lid, but I have brought it with the lid today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you brought the container empty, but had removed the lid when weighing it at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 売場ではふたの有無もそろえて重さを確認します。中身は何グラムご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here we check the weight using the same arrangement, including whether the lid is on or off. How many grams of food would you like?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二百グラムです。容器込みの重さではなく、惣菜だけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容器を含めず惣菜だけ二百グラムを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Two hundred grams, please. I mean just the food, without including the container's weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want two hundred grams of the prepared food alone, excluding the container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空容器の重さを記録しました。惣菜二百グラムを入れる形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have recorded the empty container's weight. We will put two hundred grams of food in it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この容器の線まで満たす必要はありません。二百グラムで止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器の線まで満たさず指定重量で止めてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is no need to fill it up to this line on the container. Please stop at two hundred grams.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the filling to stop at the specified weight rather than at the line on the container.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 量りました。容器の線より下ですが、惣菜の重さは二百グラムです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have weighed it. It is below the line on the container, but the food weighs two hundred grams.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その量でお願いします。容器の重さを引いた惣菜分の表示を確認して払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器重を除いた惣菜分の表示を確認して会計すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: That amount is fine, thank you. I will check the displayed food weight with the container's weight deducted, then pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will check the displayed amount for the food excluding the container's weight and then pay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが会計用の表示です。ふたをしてレジへお持ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the label for checkout. Please put the lid on and take it to the checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。道の案内が必要ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 車へ戻りたいのですが、来た道に通行止めがあります。反対側の駐車場へ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通行止めで来た道を戻れず北の駐車場へ行く経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to get back to my car, but the path I came along is closed. Can I get to the parking area on the other side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a route to the northern parking area because a closure prevents you from returning the way you came.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの地図で停めた場所を示してください。近道の橋は雨の後で閉鎖中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please point out where you parked on this map. The bridge used as a shortcut is closed after the rain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この北の駐車場です。南の出口から出れば、外を回って北へ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐車位置を地図で示し南口から外周を歩けるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this northern parking area. If I leave through the south exit, can I walk around outside to the north?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out where you parked on the map and ask in Japanese whether you can walk around the outside from the south exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 南へ出ると徒歩で北へ回る道はこの図にはありません。園内の舗装路を戻る経路をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This map does not show a walking route around to the north if you leave to the south. I will show you a route back along the paved paths inside the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長い道なら、車にいる友人に別の出口まで迎えに来てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 園内迂回が長いため車の友人に別出口への迎えを頼みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If it is a long way, I would like to ask my friend in the car to pick me up at another exit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that, because the detour inside the park is long, you would like to ask your friend in the car to pick you up at a different exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 舗装路の先の西口なら、車の乗降場所があります。そこまで歩けそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a pickup and drop-off area at the west exit farther along the paved path. Do you think you can walk that far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。西口の名前と、車が待てる場所を友人に送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 歩ける西口の名前と乗降場所を友人へ伝えると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will send my friend the west exit's name and the place where the car can wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer in Japanese that you can walk to the west exit and will tell your friend its name and the pickup and drop-off location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 門前は通行車のため空け、乗降場所で合流してください。橋へは戻らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the area in front of the gate clear for passing vehicles and meet at the pickup and drop-off area. Do not go back to the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 西口の乗降場所へ迎えを頼み、舗装路を歩きます。閉鎖橋は通りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閉鎖橋を避け舗装路で西口の乗降場所へ向かうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will arrange to be picked up at the west exit's pickup and drop-off area and walk along the paved path. I will not use the closed bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will avoid the closed bridge and follow the paved path to the pickup and drop-off area at the west exit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 西口まではこちらの線です。足元に気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03207-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: This line shows the route to the west exit. Please watch your step on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having a problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗換案内に同じホームとあるのに、待っていた列車が来ません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じホームという乗換案内なのに待つ列車が来ないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: The transfer directions say it is the same platform, but the train I have been waiting for has not come.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the train you are waiting for has not arrived even though the transfer directions say to use the same platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先を見せてください。このホームは両側に線路があります。どちらの表示を見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me your destination. There are tracks on both sides of this platform. Which side's display did you look at?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口に近い側だけ見ました。反対側の列車は別の行き先だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口側だけを見て反対側の列車を違う行き先と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only looked at the side near the entrance. I thought the train on the opposite side was going somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you only looked at the entrance side and thought the train on the opposite side had a different destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その反対側が乗換先です。予定の便は既に発車したので、次の便を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: That opposite side is where you need to change trains. The service you planned to take has already left, so let us check the next one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 走って追いかけるのはやめます。次の便も同じ側ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発車済み列車を追わず次便の発車側を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not run after it. Does the next service also leave from the same side?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not chase the departed train, and ask which side the next service leaves from.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の便は反対側です。ただし途中で止まる駅が異なります。降りたい駅はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next service is on the opposite side. However, the stations it stops at along the way are different. Where would you like to get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この地図の駅です。次の便がそこに止まるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図で降車駅を示して次便の停車を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: At this station on the map. Please tell me whether the next service stops there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out your destination station on the map and ask in Japanese whether the next service stops there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 次の便は停車します。行き先と停車駅を画面で確認してお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The next service does stop there. Please check the destination and stopping stations on the screen while you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 反対側へ移り、目的の駅に止まる次便を待ちます。同じホームでも表示を両側見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 反対側で目的駅に止まる次便を待ち両側の表示を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move to the opposite side and wait for the next service that stops at my destination. Even on the same platform, I will look at the displays on both sides.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will wait on the opposite side for the next service stopping at your destination and check the displays on both sides.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。線路へ近付かずお待ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Please wait away from the tracks. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行事について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with the event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域の行事に参加したいです。この主催者の欄に自分の名前を書けば申し込めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地域行事への参加申込みに主催者欄へ記入するのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to attend a community event. Can I sign up by writing my name in this organizer field?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you should fill in the organizer field to register to attend a community event.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様は行事を開く方ですか、それとも参加する方ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you organizing the event, or are you attending it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参加する方です。友人から紙をもらい、名前を書く場所だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人は参加者で友人からもらった紙を氏名記入用と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am attending. A friend gave me this sheet, and I thought it was where I should write my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you are an attendee and thought the sheet your friend gave you was for entering your name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: これは主催する側の利用相談用です。参加の申込先は別に案内されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is for organizers to discuss using the venue. The contact for attendance registration is provided separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 主催者としては出しません。友人が開く行事なので、友人に参加方法を聞いた方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 主催者として提出せず開催する友人へ参加方法を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not submit it as an organizer. My friend is holding the event, so I should ask my friend how to attend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will not submit the form as an organizer and will ask the friend holding the event how to attend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この紙に参加者向けの連絡先があるか、友人へ確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please check with your friend whether this sheet includes a contact for participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所も書きかけましたが、まだ渡していません。用紙は自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 住所を記入しかけたが未提出なので紙を持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I started writing my address too, but I have not handed it in yet. I will take the form home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you started entering your address but have not submitted the sheet, so you will take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 主催者の申請として受け付けることはしません。必要があれば友人本人が利用相談をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will not accept this as an organizer's application. If necessary, your friend can personally consult us about using the venue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私は参加の連絡だけ友人にします。場所の予約を代わりにしたとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人へ参加希望だけを伝え会場予約の代理をしたとは伝えないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will only tell my friend that I want to attend. I will not say that I reserved the venue on their behalf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will only tell your friend you wish to attend and will not say you made a venue reservation on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。参加と主催の区別ができましたね。ご相談ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We have clarified the difference between attending and organizing. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。問診票で分からないところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything on the medical questionnaire you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今の症状欄に昔の手術を書いてしまいました。今回の腹痛とは分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昔の手術を今回の症状欄に書いたため分けて訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote about an old operation in the current symptoms field by mistake. I would like to separate it from this episode of stomach pain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you wrote an old operation in the current symptoms field and want to correct the form to separate them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 病歴の欄もあります。手術を受けた時期は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a medical history field too. Do you know when you had the operation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五年前ですが月は覚えていません。退院時の資料を持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手術は五年前で正確な年月の資料を持参していると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was five years ago, but I do not remember the month. I have brought my discharge documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the operation was five years ago and that you brought documents showing its precise year and month.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料を医療職に見せてください。今回の痛みはいつからですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please show the documents to a medical professional. When did this pain start?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今朝からです。昔の手術と関係があるかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 腹痛は今朝からで手術との関係は分からないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: This morning. I do not know whether it is related to the operation I had before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the stomach pain started this morning and you do not know whether it is related to the operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 関係を受付で判断はしません。今朝の症状と手術歴の両方を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Reception will not determine whether there is a connection. I will tell the person in charge about both this morning's symptoms and your surgical history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書き直す紙をください。今飲んでいる薬はないことも記入したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 問診票の書き直し用紙を頼み現在服薬していないことも記入したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could I have another sheet to fill in again? I would also like to write that I am not taking any medication now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for a new medical questionnaire sheet and explain that you also want to enter that you are not currently taking medication.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらをどうぞ。詳しい症状は医療職からお尋ねします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here you are. A medical professional will ask you about your symptoms in detail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 腹痛は今朝から、手術は五年前と分けます。今の薬はないと書き、資料を診察で見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 腹痛の開始時点と手術歴と現在の服薬状態を分け資料を医療職へ示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will list the stomach pain that started this morning separately from the operation five years ago. I will write that I am not taking any medication now and show the documents during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will distinguish the onset of the stomach pain, your surgical history, and current medication status, and show the documents to a medical professional.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書き直した紙を確認します。症状が変わったらお声がけください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the replacement form. Please let us know if your symptoms change. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談の内容を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Please tell me what you would like to discuss.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 未納料金のSMSが来ました。この番号に電話して確かめた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未納SMSに記載された番号へ電話してよいか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I received a text message about unpaid charges. Should I call this number to check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether it is all right to call the number in a text message about unpaid charges.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず届いた内容を見せてください。どの会社との契約だと書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the message first. Which company does it say you have a contract with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社名はなく、利用料金とだけ書かれています。思い当たる契約はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社名がなく自分に思い当たる契約もないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is no company name; it only says usage charges. I cannot think of any relevant contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the message has no company name and you cannot think of any relevant contract.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その番号を正式な問い合わせ先とは扱えません。リンクを開いたり、情報を入力したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot treat that number as an official inquiry contact. Have you opened any links or entered any information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。でも心配なので、自分の携帯会社に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: リンク操作も情報入力もしておらず自分の携帯会社に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have done neither. But I am worried, so I would like to check with my own mobile carrier.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have neither opened the link nor entered information and want to check with your own mobile carrier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の契約書や公式アプリにある連絡先から確認してください。SMSの連絡先は使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use the contact details in your own contract or the official app to check. Do not use the contact information in the text message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 契約書の控えがあります。そこから問い合わせ、SMSは削除せず残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約書の連絡先から問い合わせSMSを保存すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have a copy of my contract. I will use that contact to inquire and keep the text message without deleting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will make an inquiry using the contract's contact details and keep the text message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認結果と受信日時を整理すると相談しやすくなります。今は支払いを急がないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Organizing the outcome of your inquiry and the date and time you received the message will make it easier to discuss. Please do not rush to pay now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受信日時を記録して携帯会社の正式窓口へ確認します。SMSの番号には折り返しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受信日時を記録して正式窓口へ確認しSMS番号には電話しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will record the date and time I received it and check with my carrier's official contact. I will not call back the number in the text message.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will record the receipt date and time, check with the official contact, and not call the number in the text message.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。結果が分かりましたらご相談ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us when you know the outcome. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお送りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. What would you like to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 切手を集める友人へ記念切手を贈ります。封筒に貼って送れば贈物になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用で贈りたい記念切手を封筒外側に貼って送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am giving commemorative stamps to a friend who collects stamps. If I stick them on the envelope and send it, will that work as a gift?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can send commemorative stamps you want to give unused by sticking them on the outside of the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その切手は未使用の状態で渡したいのですか。貼った物を郵送料に使う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you want to give those stamps in unused condition? Are you planning to use the ones you attach to pay the postage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 未使用で渡したいです。表に貼れば友人がはがせると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未使用のまま渡したいが受取人が貼った切手をはがせると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to give them unused. I thought my friend could peel them off if I put them on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you want to give the stamps unused but thought the recipient could peel them off after you attached them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵送料に使えば使用済みになります。未使用で贈る物は中へ入れ、送料は別にしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you use them for postage, they become used stamps. Put the ones you want to give unused inside and pay the postage separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では台紙に載せて中へ入れます。切手の裏にのりは付けません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 切手をのりで貼らず台紙に載せて封筒の中へ入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will put them on a backing card inside. I will not put glue on the backs of the stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will place the stamps on a backing card inside the envelope without gluing them down.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 折れないよう保護してください。封筒全体の重さを確認して送料をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please protect them from being bent. We will check the weight of the whole envelope and tell you the postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 切手の額面の合計が送料だと思っていました。中身の額面とは別なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同封切手の額面合計と必要送料を混同していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought the total face value of the stamps was the postage. So that is separate from the face value of the contents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you confused the total face value of the enclosed stamps with the required postage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。中にある切手の額面では送料を支払ったことにはなりません。外の郵送料を別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The face value of the stamps inside does not count as postage paid. We will check the postage on the outside separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 贈る切手は中で未使用のまま保護します。外の送料は重さで案内を聞いて別に払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 贈物切手は未使用で保護し外側の送料を重量案内に従って別に払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will protect the gift stamps inside and keep them unused. I will ask about the postage based on the weight and pay for it separately on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you will protect the gift stamps in unused condition and pay the outer postage separately according to the weight guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。梱包ができましたら量ります。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-03208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will weigh it when it is packed. Thank you.
